notes.title: Hey, I'm back with something new – try Dustoria!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hey everyone![/b] 👋[/p][p]I released a demo for my new game: [b]Dustoria[/b] 🌵
It's a calm and minimalist survival-builder set in a forgotten desert.
[/p][p]If you enjoyed my previous games, I’d love for you to try it out and share your thoughts.
Every bit of feedback helps a lot during this early phase![/p][p]🎮 [b]Play the demo on Steam now:[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3745010/Dustoria_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]
💬 Drop your thoughts, I’m reading everything![/p][p]Thanks for sticking around ❤️[/p]

notes.notes:

[list]
[*]Car designs do not work properly in online mode.
[*]If the host leaves the game, the mouse does not appear in the main menu.
[*]Other players' radios can be heard in online mode.
[*]If the lobby is closed, people trying to join are stuck in the endless loading screen.
[*]When I open the controls from the online settings, the settings do not close.
[*]Car design sometimes does not work in single player.
[*]Lobbies do not appear when you enter the online menu.
[*]Online mode does not work after entering single player.
[/list]
